citation: Forest County Potawatomi Cultural Center, September 26, 1833 — Treaty of Chicago, payment schedule.
locator: payment schedule entries for Nicholas Boilvin ($350) and Noel Vasseur ($800)
note: Tribal institutional transcription of the 1833 Treaty of Chicago payment schedule. T-0484 uses it to corroborate the exact uncommon names Nicholas Boilvin and Noel Vasseur in treaty-era Chicago activity; a treaty payment does not by itself prove a July 1, 1835 Chicago dwelling.
